attempts.summary: Configured zram-generator on node1 to create a ~980MB zstd-compressed in-memory swap device (zram0) with swap-priority 100, exceeding the disk-backed swap (/dev/vda3, priority -2), so zram is preferred and satisfies the 512MB minimum. The unit activates automatically at boot via the systemd generator (no manual enable needed since it's config-driven). Verified persistence by restarting node1: boot_id/uptime changed, confirming an actual reboot, and post-restart the zram0 swap device reappeared active, correctly sized, zstd-compressed, and prioritized above disk swap.
